camera.orientation: camera is above +Z and looks straight down -Z; head/forward +X projects toward token top; tail/rear projects toward token bottom
camera.framing: fixed scale with ground origin at token [50,57]
camera.depthOrder: far-to-near camera depth; higher +Z surfaces render nearer; stable semantic-id tie break

idleA.motionSemantics: quiet cow breathing and gentle chewing, neck counter-motion and ear/tail movement above four fixed hooves

walkA.motionSemantics: baked sagittal IK; shoulder/hip swing, elbow/stifle flexion, opposing hind hock; planted stance and raised swing

attack.motionSemantics: authored hornless cow shove: weight gathering, slight forehead lowering, forward shoulder/head press, sustained contact and recover; four fixed hooves and modest body pitch, no upward goring toss

profile.silhouette: hornless cow: deep stout barrel, rounded hindquarters and lighter neck, long muzzle, sideways ears, low udder and long tufted tail
profile.locomotion: four-beat cattle walk and quick gallop with articulated carpi, stifles and hocks
profile.attack: authored shove: gather weight, lower forehead slightly, press forward with shoulder/head, hold and recover
